_doc: Known emulator bugs. Key: <mod>.<case> (fnmatch patterns allowed). configs: fnmatch glob(s) on the matrix entry id. when: Amiberry options that must have these values. tbd: the case id is a placeholder until the module lands; fix the key then. A failing match is xfail; a passing match is reported as fixed. See runner/amitorture/xfail.py.

fpu.frestore_null_nan.why: native FPU (fpp_native.cpp): FRESTORE of a NULL frame must reset FP0-FP7 to non-signalling NaNs (MC68881/882 UM 6.4.2 / M68000PRM FRESTORE); the native path did not
fpu.frestore_null_nan.seen: matched failing cases on a4000-68040nommu-fast/-jit and a4000-68060nommu-fast/-jit (smoke, 2026-11-03); passes on master 435db0509 (fixed by #2594)

fpu.inf_roundtrip.why: native FPU: after PR #2594 infinities survive FMOVE.X in/out, but a QNaN's mantissa payload does not (7fff0000.c0000000.00000000 comes back as 7fff0000.ffffffff.ffffffff): fp_from_exten writes all-ones for every NaN; the host double cannot hold the 63-bit payload (finding F1)
fpu.inf_roundtrip.seen: matched failing cases on a4000-68040nommu-fast/-jit and a4000-68060nommu-fast/-jit (smoke, 2026-11-03)

cpu_basic.div_w.why: DIVU.W overflow leaves C set on 68020/030: setdivuflags() (newcpu_common.cpp) clears C only for 000/010/040/060; PRM says C always cleared. WinUAE identical; confirm on a real 68020

cpu_basic.movem_w.why: ARM64 JIT MOVEM.W memory-to-register, special-memory path: readword() without sign_extend_16_rr, so the upper word is 0 instead of the sign (op_4c90..4cbb_0_comp_ff/_nf in compemu_arm.cpp; the x86 JIT has the sign extension). comp_trustbyte=indirect sends every access down that path

dispatch.c040_s2.why: trustbyte-ind: bset d0,-(a2) after bchg d7,d2 returns the N/V/C flags from before the preceding MOVEQ (the _comp_nf BCHG calls dont_care_flags(), so the helper call of the next memory access does not save NZCV); trustlong-ind: bfins with a constant negative offset register (J8)
dispatch.c040_s2.seen: amitorture standard run 20261104-001719Z, triage 2026-11-04; see docs/findings/amiberry-2026-11-03.md

dispatch.c0[024]0_s[123].why: on comp_trustbyte=indirect the first failing block of these dispatch cases is a MOVEM.W to registers without sign extension (J10); c020_s2/c040_s1 are matched by their J8 entries first
dispatch.c0[024]0_s[123].seen: amitorture standard run 20261104-001719Z, triage 2026-11-04; see docs/findings/amiberry-2026-11-03.md

memory.rom_write.why: protect_roms() (osdep/amiberry_mem.cpp:1284) leaves the ROM pages writable when any comp_trust* is indirect, but on ARM64 only comp_trustbyte=indirect makes every access indirect: with comp_trustword/comp_trustlong=indirect the other sizes are still direct native stores, so a compiled write lands in the Kickstart ROM (the case then reads its own value back and reports skip instead of pass)
memory.rom_write.seen: amitorture standard run 20261104-001719Z, triage 2026-11-04; see docs/findings/amiberry-2026-11-03.md
